scope.summary: From upstream packages, base images and PR-controlled build inputs through review, queue validation and OCI publication to the pins consumed by ArgoCD.
scope.built: BuildBuddy runs pr-checks on PR heads, queue candidates and main. The factory Renovate App requests native auto-merge. Hub apko maintenance is suspended. The monolith dependency evidence path is distinct from the required factory review.

losses.title: Unreviewed software gains deploy authority on a cluster.

hazards.statement: A merge or deployment refers to inputs other than those validated.

ucas.condition: Requesting auto-merge for a protected path or major update would remove the manual decision. Renovate restricts eligible update classes and overrides eligibility for protected paths.
An unattended refresh could change image inputs during retirement. The hub CronWorkflow consumes the suspend flag and automatic merge is disabled.
Accepting a partial dependency graph would hide transitive changes. The intake parser refuses missing or truncated evidence.
A pass for another PR revision could authorize changed code. The reviewer matches the reviewed head to the queued PR head.
Enqueue after the reviewed head moves would change the candidate. The connector supplies expectedHeadOid and the ruleset requires pr-checks and factory review.

A success for a different tree could admit an untested build. PR checks use the PR head and queue pushes trigger a separate candidate build. Same-repository jobs cross the runner credential boundary (buildbuddy.yaml:44).
Publishing during PR validation would promote candidate artifacts. The runner selects publication on main and build verification on PR and queue runs.
Advancing a pin before publication would direct GitOps to an unconfirmed release. The runner passes publication records to write-back after publishing.

unsafe_feedback.condition: A stale approval could pass the queue candidate. The reviewer compares the head SHA before posting the merge-group check.
unsafe_feedback.signal: factory review conclusion for PR head
